summary: Materialized/read full AQUINAS-DE-ENTE-C3-4 and newly pinned publisher CC-BY Pearce 2025 witness PEARCE-GROUNDING-INDETERMINISM-303-322 (two matching byte/text fetches; §§1–4 and6–7 plus selected §5 context read). Note44’s qualitative-ground reply challenges essential existence rather than refuting minimal modal necessary existence under necessitarian assumptions. Sections16–17 defend burden symmetry, explicitly not PSR truth. Rejected ingredient-alone sufficiency, literal self-grounding, own-nature/accessible-world equivalence and essential-fact→actual-concrete bearer. Updated the existing candidate; no Lean theorem or root-premise discharge.
